do_not_infer: regional resident totals beyond the package population sum
required_elements: Extract rock mass, maximum runup, Sentinel-1 absolute change, median precipitation, population sum, and event-window day count.
Apply all threshold flags before scoring the candidates.
Return the candidate scores and the winning-score gap.
Tie the final interpretation to the score ledger rather than broad prose.

key_values.computed_interpretation: The mass and runup thresholds dominate the ledger; precipitation and population tests do not make the non-landslide candidates competitive.

primary_gt.computed_interpretation: The mass and runup thresholds dominate the ledger; precipitation and population tests do not make the non-landslide candidates competitive.

criteria.description: Returns landslide_displacement_tsunami as the winner with score 9, runner-up radar_change_standalone, and gap 7.
criteria.name: Final label and score gap
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct winner with an incomplete gap or runner-up; award 1 point for a landslide-tsunami label without a computed score.

criteria.description: Extracts about 180 million tons and about 193 m, then marks both mass_ge_100 and runup_ge_100 true.
criteria.name: Report-text numeric extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct report-text value or for correct values with one threshold flag reversed.

criteria.description: Computes Sentinel-1 absolute change near 50.5 dB, uses counts 7 and 5, and computes a one-day locked event window.
criteria.name: Radar and window ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the radar magnitude or the window count if the other part is missing.

criteria.description: Uses the four non-null precipitation estimates to get a median near 39.7 mm and marks precip_median_ge_50 false.
criteria.name: Precipitation median test
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the right precipitation sources with a small rounding or median error.

criteria.description: Uses WorldPop population sum near 0.088 and marks population_lt_1 true.
criteria.name: Population threshold test
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct low-population direction without the numeric value.

criteria.description: Computes the candidate scores as 9, 0, 2, and 1 from the stated formulas.
criteria.name: Candidate score arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for mostly correct score components with one candidate arithmetic error.

criteria.description: Explains that the mass and runup thresholds dominate while rainfall and population tests do not beat the score ledger.
criteria.name: Compact computed interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a concise interpretation tied to some, but not all, decisive score components.
